name: How does surface preparation affect the lifespan of a new coating or flooring?

mainEntity.name: How does surface preparation affect the lifespan of a new coating or flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Effective surface preparation is directly correlated with the lifespan and performance of new coatings or flooring. A properly prepared surface ensures strong adhesion between the substrate and the new material, preventing common failures like delamination, bubbling, or cracking. Without adequate preparation, contaminants or an improper surface profile can compromise the bond, leading to premature wear and failure, significantly shortening the lifespan of the new application.
acceptedAnswer.description: Proper surface preparation ensures strong adhesion, directly extending the lifespan of new coatings or flooring by preventing premature failures like delamination or cracking.
